{{Quote|I understand why so many have turned from the path. Would you stop me from doing the same?|Duqua Dar, to the Republic agents|<ref name="ID" />}}
'''Duqua Dar''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]], which began in [[3976 BBY]]. During the war, he served alongside fellow Zabrak [[Acaadi]], allying himself with the [[Revanchist]]s&mdash;a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by then-Jedi Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;who went against the orders of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and took an active role in the war. Revan led the Republic forces during the war but came to accept [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings in the process.

At the start of the [[Jedi Civil War]], which began when [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan, by then a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malak]] led an invasion of the Republic in [[3959 BBY]], Dar was fighting the remaining Mandalorians on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. When Dar intercepted a group of Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who had attacked a Republic communications center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], he was aided by Acaadi, now a Sith agent, who used the encounter to persuade Dar to join him and the Sith. Dar and Acaadi traveled to the nearby town of [[Wortan]], pursued by a group of Jedi and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working as agents for the Republic, who attempted to thwart Acaadi's plans. Tracking them back to Acaadi's personal [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], the Republic agents attempted to convince Dar to reject the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], before being attacked by a number of [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith commandos]] under Acaadi's command.

==Biography==
===Mandalorian Wars===
{{Quote|You didn't listen to me back then, and where did it get you? Nowhere.|Acaadi, to Duqua Dar|<ref name="ID" />}}
[[File:Iridonia.jpg|250px|thumb|Duqua Dar's homeworld of Irodonia]]
The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Duqua Dar was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]], beginning [[3976 BBY]]. During the early part of the Mandalorian Wars, Dar joined the [[Revanchist]]s&mdash;a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by then-Jedi Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;who went against the orders of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and took an active role in the conflict. Leading the Republic forces in the war, Revan discovered ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings and came to embrace them. As a member of the Revanchists, Dar served alongside fellow Zabrak Jedi [[Acaadi]], before Acaadi's dedication to Revan eventually turned him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] as well. Dar resisted the call of the dark side, however, and remained on the Zabrak [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], though he believed that his destiny lay elsewhere.<ref name="ID" />

At the start of the [[Jedi Civil War]], which began when [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malak]] led an invasion of the Republic in [[3959 BBY]],<ref name="KotORI">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Dar was fighting the remaining Mandalorians still present on Iridonia. Under orders from the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], Dar intercepted a group of Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who had attacked a Republic communications center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Mandalorians almost proved too much for Dar, but he was saved by the timely intervention of Acaadi, now a Sith agent, who used the encounter to persuade Dar to join him and possibly turn him to the dark side. Dar was convinced that the Jedi Order had been holding him back, preventing him from using his natural aggressive feelings. Unaware that it had been Acaadi who had ordered the Mandalorians to attack the communications center in preparation for a planned Sith attack on Iridonia, Dar decided to join Acaadi. The conversation between the two Zabrak was overheard via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] by a group of Jedi and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] under orders from the Republic, who had earlier defeated another group of Mandalorians that had ambushed them. Unaware that Dar had agreed to join Acaadi, they decided to go to Dar's aid.<ref name="ID" />

===Confrontation in Acaadi's hangar===
{{Quote|Too late and ineffectual. That is so often the way of the Jedi and their Republic allies these days.|Duqua Dar, to the Republic agents|<ref name="ID" />}}
[[File:WortanMap-ID.png|250px|thumb|left|Wortan, the location of Acaadi's private hangar]]
Dar and Acaadi traveled to Acaadi's private [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the town of Wortan, with the Republic agents in pursuit. Reaching Wortan, the Republic agents searched the town for the two Zabrak and, with the help of two Force-users, [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] [[Darok-Tho]] and [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jirany Sha]], managed to locate Acaadi's hangar. Acaadi detected the group as they approached and planned to have the Republic agents meet with Dar in the hangar.<ref name="ID" />

Just as the agents arrived, Acaadi left the planet in his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], heading to sabotage the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Champion of Iridonia]]'', which was situated in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Dar met with the Republic agents as Acaadi planned, who attempted to convince him to reject the dark side. During their conversation, Dar attempted to justify joining the Sith by pointing out holes in the Jedi teachings. After Dar talked with the Republic agents, a group of [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith commandos]] attacked the agents at Acaadi's command. The agents defeated the commandos, however, and proceeded to travel to the ''Champion of Iridonia'' in an attempt to save the Republic fleet from Acaadi.<ref name="ID" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The Jedi way was not for me, and we both know that it is not truly for you either.|Acaadi, convincing Duqua Dar to leave the Jedi path|<ref name="ID" />}}
Duqua Dar was a conflicted Jedi, who, in the aftermath of the Mandalorian Wars, resisted the call of the dark side and remained on the Zabrak homeworld of Iridonia. At the same time, however, he believed that his destiny belonged elsewhere. Dar's mind and body bore the scars of the Mandalorian Wars, making him highly emotional and on edge. He was convinced that the Jedi Order had been holding him back, preventing him from using his natural aggressive feelings. When Acaadi persuaded Dar to join him, Dar attempted to justify joining the Sith by pointing out holes in the Jedi teachings.<ref name="ID" />

A native of Iridonia, Dar was able to speak both [[Zabraki/Legends|Zabraki]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="ID" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Is it so wrong to embrace one's own abilities, one's natural power?|Duqua Dar|<ref name="ID" />}}
Duqua Dar was an experienced Jedi who had been [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in both the [[Force power/Legends|use of the Force]] as well as [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. In combat, Dar preferred to concentrate on his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] defenses, bolstered by the Force. He was skilled in [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] applications of the Force, able to move objects and create a whirlwind around an opponent. Dar could also [[Force stealth|hide his Force presence]] from other Force-users at will, allowing him to escape detection.<ref name="ID" />

==Equipment==
Duqua Dar wore dark brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] that at the time of meeting the Republic agents displayed battle damage, including scorched blaster burns, torn sleeves, and dirt. Dar carried a lightsaber he had built.<ref name="ID" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duqua Dar made his first appearance in ''[[Iridonian Darkness]]'', a [[Wizards of the Coast]] online adventure for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', which was made available as a free download from [[Wizards.com]] in [[October 8]], [[2008]].<ref name="ID" />

In ''Iridonian Darkness'', depending on the actions of the players, Dar can either fall to the dark side or join tehm as a Jedi once again. If Dar decides to remain a Jedi, he will aid the Republic agents in the fight with the Sith commandos and encourage them to capture a nearby [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. If, however, Dar falls to the dark side, he will defend himself against the agents and retreat to the ship himself. Providing that Dar survives the encounter, he would likely be in no shape to help either the Republic agents or the Sith, but he will aid his chosen allies if possible.<ref name="ID" />
